Plan, not record. September 2026 has not happened. This is what the planner would do, day by day, produced by the simulator that backtested August to within a fraction of a percent. Forecast demand is marked FORECAST; every declared assumption is flagged in the data. WhatsApp messages are simulated drafts — nothing was sent, nobody replied.

News of the day

48 PO landings · 105 real order rows · 67 forecast rows

Purchase orders landing at the gate are the plan's only external arrivals — each lands when its assumed lead time runs out, and on some days nothing lands. Orders are split hard: real rows are the measured SAP backlog entering by promise date; forecast rows are the plan wearing a date — nobody has ordered them.

MEASUREDDay 1 is a pile, and the pile is real.
the day-1 order pile is MEASURED reality, not a bug — most of the open backlog was already overdue on 31 Aug.
Within the sim's world — the 84 plan SKUs — the frozen opening carries 47 open order documents, 40 of them already overdue on 31 Aug. Most of that slice enters as the pile below — the rest enters on later days, by promise date; the whole slice is worth ₹28.23 Cr across 12,88,754 pieces. The SAP-wide count is a different, wider fact — quoted in full provenance:
the demand stream's full provenance, verbatim
Two streams: (1) the SAP ORDR open backlog, real orders, dated by PROMISE (DocDueDate; measured 2026-08-31: 131 of 138 open docs already overdue, so most enter day 1 — the state of the book, not an assumption); (2) the plan as a FORECAST for demand not yet ordered, net of the backlog: EXIM's weekly buckets where they exist (trade 1,890,300 L), plus the un-bucketed ecom volume (2,433,000 L — EXIM has no ecom weekly split) spread evenly across the month's working days as week 0. ASSUMPTION: the even ecom spread. Stream 2 is a projection, tagged channel=FORECAST so it can be separated on the site. NOT the OMS mirror (dead, unjoinable). SCOPE: the backlog counted here covers the 84 plan SKUs only — open FG orders on non-plan codes are outside the sim's world (it cannot produce them) and are counted separately in opening.backlog_nonplan_*. VALUE BASIS: order value = OpenQty x unit Price, the open pieces' worth — SUM(LineTotal) was refuted (it includes the delivered part of part-shipped lines; Rs 14.4 Cr / 44% overstatement).

This is a forward plan, not a record. September 2026 has not happened; only the 1-September opening is observed. The factory has not run this way.
Measured: the 31-Aug stock and open POs, the open order backlog, BOMs, line speeds and clearance, realise, lead times. Assumed (declared, flagged in the data): forecast demand buckets for volume not yet ordered, the even ecom spread, supply exactly on lead time, the invoice→truck lag, the observed line-efficiency derate, the storage ceiling (open question Q2), standing stock uncounted at open. Phone numbers are masked — September has no approval to show them.
